archetypes.name: The Night Owl Creative
archetypes.line: Up late, making things, with a playlist nobody else has heard.

archetypes.name: The Weekend Explorer
archetypes.line: If there’s a trail, a flight or a new spot, you’re already on it.

archetypes.name: The Cozy Curator
archetypes.line: Blanket, a perfect rewatch and snacks you’d defend with your life.

archetypes.name: The Social Spark
archetypes.line: The group chat runs on you. So does the weekend.

archetypes.name: The Competitor
archetypes.line: Ranked, timed or scored. You play to win.

archetypes.name: The Planner
archetypes.line: Spreadsheets for vacations. Budgets that actually work.

archetypes.name: The Main Character
archetypes.line: Good fits, good lighting, better stories.

archetypes.name: The Deep Diver
archetypes.line: Three podcasts deep and a Wikipedia tab you’ll never close.

archetypes.name: The Homebody Gamer
archetypes.line: Headset on, snacks close, one more match.

archetypes.name: The Wellness Seeker
archetypes.line: Sleep score, step count and a smoothie that took twenty minutes.

archetypes.name: The Trend Hunter
archetypes.line: You knew about it first. Then everyone else found out.

archetypes.name: The Old Soul
archetypes.line: Records, paperbacks and a strong opinion about the classics.

archetypes.name: The Builder
archetypes.line: Side projects, tabs of docs and a tool for everything.

archetypes.name: The Nest Builder
archetypes.line: Plants watered, dinner planned, people you love around the table.
